Front: Sample variance dùng n−1 thay vì n — tên correction là gì và tại sao?
Back: Bessel's Correction: khi dùng x̄ thay μ thật, variance bị underestimate vì sample data gần x̄ hơn μ. Chia n−1 hiệu chỉnh bias → unbiased estimator. Code: np.var(data, ddof=1). Interview classic: 'Why n−1?'

Front: Population mean = {{c1::μ (mu)}}, sample mean = {{c2::x̄ (x-bar)}}. Sample variance unbiased = {{c3::s² = Σ(xᵢ−x̄)²/(n−1)}}. SE = {{c4::s/√n}} đo độ chính xác của x̄.
Back: Notation: Population (N,μ,σ²) vs Sample (n,x̄,s²). SE→0 khi n→∞ (LLN). CLT: √n·(x̄−μ)/σ → N(0,1) khi n→∞.

Front: Viết numpy tính mean, std unbiased (ddof=1), median, và IQR cho array d.
Back:
import numpy as np
mean = np.mean(d)
std = np.std(d, ddof=1)
median = np.median(d)
q1, q3 = np.percentile(d, [25, 75])
iqr = q3 - q1

Front: Outlier làm mean bị kéo mạnh, nhưng {{c1::median}} robust. IQR rule detect outlier: Q1−{{c2::1.5·IQR}} và Q3+1.5·IQR. Trong ML preprocessing: Winsorize hoặc log-transform để giảm skew.
Back: Mean sensitive outlier; median stable. IQR robust spread metric. Outlier via IQR rule. ML preprocessing: cap extreme, log-transform positive skew, standardize after taming outliers.

Front: CLT: √n·(x̄−μ)/σ → {{c1::Normal(0,1)}} cho n→∞. Điều kiện: {{c2::finite variance}}. n≥{{c3::30}} rough rule. Dùng để justify z/t-test cho metric ML dù data skewed.
Back: CLT foundation cho confidence interval, hypothesis test. Heavy-tail (Cauchy) no finite variance → not apply. Trong ML: evaluate model accuracy mean là Normal distributed for large n via CLT.

Front: Viết code scipy tính 95% CI cho sample data dùng t-distribution (unknown σ).
Back:
from scipy import stats
import numpy as np

data = np.array([...])
n = len(data)
mean = np.mean(data)
sem = np.std(data, ddof=1) / np.sqrt(n)
ci = stats.t.interval(0.95, df=n-1, loc=mean, scale=sem)

Front: 95% t-CI = x̄ ± t_{0.025}·s/√n. Với n nhỏ, t CI {{c1::rộng hơn z-CI}} vì {{c2::đuôi dày hơn của t-dist}}. Khi n>30, t ≈ {{c3::z}}. CI ≠ prob μ trong interval — đó là Bayesian credible interval.
Back: CI interpretation tricky: 95% CI means 95 of 100 repeated experiments would contain μ. Not probability statement. Frequentist CI wording common interview question.

Front: 6 bước hypothesis test: 1. {{c1::H₀,H₁}}  2. {{c2::α}}  3. test  4. statistic  5. {{c3::p-value}}  6. {{c4::kết luận}}. p≤α→reject H₀ (evidence thôi, không prove H₁).
Back: Hypothesis testing systematic: pre-register H₀/H₁, α=0.05 common. compute test statistic → reference distribution → p-value tail area. p small → evidence against H₀ strong.

Back:
from scipy import stats
t_stat, p_val = stats.ttest_ind(group_A, group_B, equal_var=False)

Front: Student t-test giả equal variance → {{c1::biased}} khi var khác nhau. Correct default: {{c2::Welch t-test (equal_var=False)}}. Paired t: {{c3::ttest_rel}}. Check normality trước: {{c4::shapiro test}}.
Back: Welch fix df + yield reliable p-value for unequal var — always use Welch practice. Paired for before-after same subject. Normality check: Shapiro p>0.05 suggest Normality for t-test; bootstrap for uncertain.

Front: Type I = {{c1::reject H₀ khi đúng}} (false positive, α=0.05). Type II = {{c2::miss effect thật}} (β). Power = {{c3::1−β}}. Giảm α → {{c4::tăng β}}. Tăng sample → {{c5::cải thiện cả 2}}.
Back: Tradeoff α↓→β↑ harder to prove. Power analysis pre-experiment để tính n cần cho power≥0.8 (80%). dùng effect size expected.

Front: Viết power analysis tính sample size cho 2 group, effect 0.5, power 0.8, α=0.05.
Back:
from statsmodels.stats.power import TTestIndPower
analysis = TTestIndPower()
n = analysis.solve_power(effect_size=0.5, power=0.8, alpha=0.05)

Front: P-value = prob dưới H₀ có statistic ≥ extreme quan sát. {{c1::Không phải P(H₀ true)}}. p<0.05 ≠ {{c2::effect size lớn}}. Đánh thêm {{c3::CI + effect size}}. Fix multiple testing: {{c4::Bonferroni α/m}}.
Back: P-value correct ASA interpretation. P-hacking = manipulate data đến khi p<.05 (peek mid-experiment, DV post-hoc). Fix: pre-register analysis plan, sequential test method valid.

Front: Bootstrap: resample với replacement B lần → bootstrap distribution ước lượng sampling distribution. Code: boot_stat = [np.median({{c1::np.random.choice(data, n, replace=True)}}) for _ in range(1000)]. Cho Random Forest: bootstrap {{c2::aggregation (bagging)}}.
Back: Bootstrap EF way approximate CI mét k does not require normality. Bagging = train ensemble model trên bootstrap replicate → reduce variance. Code pattern loop.

Back:
import numpy as np
boot = [np.median(np.random.choice(data, n, replace=True)) for _ in range(1000)]
ci_lo, ci_hi = np.percentile(boot, [2.5, 97.5])

Front: ANOVA 1-way: F = (between-var)/(within-var). Code: {{c1::st.f_oneway(g1,g2,g3)}}. Nếu reject → cần {{c2::post-hoc Tukey}}. ANOVA tốt hơn {{c3::pairwise t-tests}} vì kiểm soát FWER (family-wise error).
Back: Why ANOVA not multiple t-tests: 3 group → 3 t-tests → cumulative Type I inflated 1−(0.95³)≈0.14>. ANOVA 1 test overall → then post-hoc subset.

Front: Viết ANOVA 1-way + Levene check homogeneity variance cho 3 group.
Back:
from scipy import stats
f_stat, p_a = stats.f_oneway(g1, g2, g3)
W, p_lev = stats.levene(g1, g2, g3)
# p_lev < .05 → variance không h omogeneous → Kruskal-Wallis hoặc Welch ANOVA

Front: A/B test conversion 2 tỷ lệ: H₀ convA=convB, test = {{c1::proportions_ztest}}. Trước: {{c2::power analysis tính n}}. 4 pitfalls A/B: {{c3::peeking (p-hacking), novelty, Simpson paradox, network spillover}}.
Back: A/B ML Engineering: z-test cho proportion; begin power tính n cần. 4 pitfalls:Peek → sequential valid method, novelty→run long enough stabilize, Simpson→stratified segment, network→cluster random.

Front: Correlation ρ chỉ linear r ∈ [−1,1]. ρ≠causation. Cho Y=X² → Pearson {{c1::≈0}} (không linear). Dùng {{c2::Spearman}} đo monotonic; {{c3::Mutual Info}} đo phi tuyến chung. VIF>10 → {{c4::multicoll. → PCA / bỏ feature.}}
Back: Correlation pitfalls: ρ nonzero không causation; check randomized. Pearson only linear — Spearman for monotonic; mutual info sklearn nonlinear detect. VIF>10 feature redundant ultrasin kernel di R area mane.

Front: Bayesian vs Frequentist: Parameter θ in Frequentist {{c1::fixed unknown constant}}; in Bayesian {{c2::random variable with distribution}}. Bayesian include {{c3::prior knowledge}}. Prior N(0,τ²)→MAP={{c4::L2 regularization}}.
Back: Bridge Bayesian↔regularization: choose prior → MAP=MLE+regularizer. Frequentist easier compute analytic NHẸ (load, p-value, z-test). Bayesian đẹp viaong thuộc integrate prior, computational heavy nhưng modern variational wide. Picking: Full Bayesian VAE encoder posterior don believe.

Front: Chọn survivor bias WWII example: chỉ phân tích máy bay sống sót → bỏ qua máy bị bắn {{c1::động cơ}}. Survivorship bias trong ML: chỉ train trên successful data, bỏ qua failure → model {{c2::optimistic estimate}}.
Back: Survivorship bias: analyzing only those survived → miss unobserved failure. ML: training data chỉ include thành công → model overfit on supervisor privileged subset. Include negative examples and failure observations.
